title: DeltaBench: Can Large Language Models Detect Errors in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning?

rs.key_step: GPT4把长CoT分成subtask sections，人标全部错误/有用性/反思；用PRM阈值或critic标出错误section。
rs.why_non_obvious: 最终错答不足定位全部局部错误，长CoT与短step PRM分布不同。
rs.trigger_condition: When long reasoning hides local errors, evaluate all human-annotated sections rather than only the first error.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When an outcome obscures intermediate failures, evaluate structured local annotations.

signatures.information: 1236人工标注样本、48subcategories，多个生成模型
signatures.operation: PRM以datasetreward均值减std阈值，critic预测所有errorsections，macroF1评估
signatures.failure_boundary: 人工subjectivity、错误预筛选与dataset阈值，不能作为普遍过程reward校准。

relevance.how: 错误定位能力不足警示自纠错/过程judge，但无训练机制。
